segments.reason: Probe, then wrong-option refutation with sure_note and a Show-me exit on most traps (S1.t_fnac to S1.x_key, S1.p3_repeat, S1.p5_calc); retests in S1.p2 to S1.p5 and S8.h1 hold the same ideas.

Biggest retry-only segment: S2.pap_t5a, S2.pap_t5b, S2.side_t5, S2.fol_t4a, S2.fol_t4b, S2.common_t3, S2.iodine_t3, S2.iodine_partial, S2.niftp_t6a, S2.niftp_t6b, S2.vig_t6, S2.vig_t4 and S2.ftest_t1a/t1b give 'Try again' and nothing else, so a learner holding the papillae or follicular-default model loops back to the same probe.

Predict-then-show chain (S3.fol_predict, S3.fol_explain, S3.pap_contrast) with Show-me on each wrong route; the lateral 'aberrant thyroid' pair (S3.lat_probe, S3.lat_retest) separates the ectopia model from the nodal model well.
Bethesda ladder with a worked case (S4.w1 to S4.w2) then faded probes (S4.f1, S4.f2, S4.f3); each category error has its own feedback. S4.h2_t1 and S4.h2_t2 are retry-only.

No Show-me exit anywhere in the segment: all twelve trap feedback nodes (S5.u1_t1, S5.u1_t2, S5.u2_t1, S5.u2_t2, S5.u3_t1, S5.u3_t2, S5.u4_t1, S5.u4_t2, S5.u5_t1, S5.u5_t2, S5.u6_t1, S5.u6_t2) offer only 'Try again'. The radioiodine and TSH ladder is clear, but the wrong models are named without a second explanation.

Worked case S6.w1 then faded probes with Show-me on TR16, TR28, TR30, TR7 and TR3 distractors (S6.fade1_t16_x, S6.fade2_a_x, S6.fade3_a_x, S6.fade5_50_x, S6.fade7_a_x); the fade4 mechanism probe is strong. S6.fade2_a and S6.fade2_b test the same model twice.

Every complication probe has a Show-me exit and a bedside-first sequence (S7.neck, S7.airway). Shared explanation nodes (S7.singer_show, S7.neck_show, S7.voice_show) name both wrong models. S7.dayone_haem's Show-me goes to a hypocalcaemia-only explanation.

Cold mixed quiz with good fresh stems (S8.k1 is a strong three-trap node), but every trap feedback is retry-only, no hints, and S8.h1 to S8.h6 re-ask traps already fixed in S1 to S7. Keys are findable by form in S8.k3, S8.k5 and S8.k6.

best_parts: node S8.k1: three look-alike wrong answers each mapped to a different trap (TR10, TR11, TR12) for one cold lateral-node stem; the strongest diagnostic node in the module.
nodes S1.t_fnac then S1.x_key: the 'first' versus 'investigation of choice' split is named, the old PYQ key is explained, and the learner is sent back to re-test in S1.p2.
nodes S6.w1 then S6.fade1 to S6.fade4: a worked follow-up ladder, faded into probes, with the refractory-disease mechanism (S6.fade4 correct) that answers the Tg-plus-negative-scan trap.

nodes S7.neck, S7.neck_show, S7.airway: the bedside clot-first rule with two different wrong models (intubate first, theatre first) each named in its own feedback, then a second case that tests the reverse (flat neck, airway first).
flaws: nodes S2.pap_t5a and S2.pap_t5b: refutation is 'Try again' only, with no Show-me or second explanation. A learner who keeps the papillae model returns to S2.pap_ask with the same information; the sim walk looped about 100 times here before the belief changed (R2, R5).
nodes S5.u1_t1 to S5.u6_t2 (all twelve trap feedbacks): no Show-me exit in the whole segment, so the radioiodine ladder has no second explanation for any wrong model (R5, R9).

nodes S2.fol_t4a and S2.fol_t4b: the key idea 'invasion is a histology feature' is stated once in feedback and never restated before 'Try again' returns the learner to the same probe; add a Show-me that names the cytology model (R2).
node S4.h2_t1 and S4.h2_t2: retry-only feedback on the scan-before-FNAC trap, the same ordering error the module names as TR1 (R5).

node S8.k3 (correct 'Lobectomy or total thyroidectomy, both acceptable') and S8.k5 (correct 'Undetectable thyroglobulin, no antibodies, clear neck ultrasound'): the key is the only hedged or longest option, so it is findable by form (R2).
node S8.k6 (correct 'Hypocalcaemia is the commonest, though nerve injury is feared most'): the only option with a concession clause, so the key can be picked without the content (R2, R6).

node S8.h1_t1 to S8.k6_t3 (all cold-check trap feedbacks): 'Try again' returns to the same cold stem with no hint and no Show-me; the sim walk notes that S8.h1 to S8.k6 re-ask traps already fixed in S1 to S7, so the segment adds load without new diagnosis (R3, R4, R8).

nodes S6.fade2_a and S6.fade2_b: two distractors test the same wrong model (an undetectable thyroglobulin settles it) with near-identical feedback; one can be dropped or replaced with a different wrong model, for example a repeated scan (R9).
node S7.dayone_haem: the Show-me goes to S7.dayone_show, which explains hypocalcaemia only and never addresses the haematoma model the learner held (R9).
coverage: O3 asks for the commonest mutation (BRAF) and no node on any path teaches it; K123 is cited by O3 but not used in any node (R3, R6).

coverage: O10 names oncocytic, microcarcinoma and prognosis as look-alikes. Oncocytic appears only inside S3.dtc_ok, microcarcinoma only in S4.t1_t2 and S4.x5, and prognostic factors (K74) only inside S5.u5_t2 as a risk-class aside, with no node placing them (R3).

voice: the stock opener 'That choice is not right.' and the stock 'You were sure, so ...' sure_note repeat across roughly 60 feedback nodes, and the tone goes flat by the middle of S2 (R8). Example: S2.pap_t5a, S5.u3_t1, S8.k6_t1.

report_check.headline: The three headline texts are accurate and the 'mixed' band fits the misconceived walk, but none of them says which wrong model to fix first beyond card order (R9).
report_check.objectives: All ten objectives use near-identical 'secure / shaky / gap' templates. O3's text omits the commonest-mutation part and O10's gap text omits the look-alikes, so the report says less than the objective asks (R3, R9).
report_check.traps: Every trap uses one of three fixed phrases ('Under pressure the X can return'). They are accurate for the walk but read the same across traps, and a misconceived learner who corrected each belief gets 'fell_recovered' for all twenty (R9).
report_check.calibration: Overconfident wording is clear and tied to the Sure taps. Underconfident is present but not reached on the misconceived walk (R9, minor).
report_check.next_steps: The order of confident errors, then gaps, then shaky items is concrete and useful (R9).

sim_check.misconceived: Consistent with sim/misconceived.md: the path names each wrong model at the point of choice, and the report names the model back by trap. Friction the sim raised still stands: retry-only refutations in S2 and S5, the cold-check S8 re-asking fixed traps, and two ideas in S3.dtc_ok. The sim rates engagement 3 and R9 4 for the path; this judge scores the path 4 for R9 but the report 3, so R9 is 3 overall.
sim_check.suggested_fix_order: Add Show-me exits to the S2 and S5 trap feedbacks first; then fix the S8 cold-check stems; then add BRAF and the prognosis node for O3 and O10.

merge_ideas: Give every retry-only trap feedback (S2.pap_t5a, S2.fol_t4a, S5.u1_t1 to S5.u6_t2) a Show-me exit that names the wrong model, as S7.neck_show does for two models at once.
Use S6.fade1 to S6.fade4 (worked case then faded probes with Show-me) as the template for S5 radioiodine, which has no fade and no exit.

Make S8 a true cold quiz: new hosts for the TR3, TR5 and TR8 stems, cut the stems that re-ask traps already fixed in S1 to S7, and rewrite the hedged or longest keys (S8.k3, S8.k5, S8.k6) to the same length as the distractors.
Add one short node in S2 or S8 for the commonest mutation (BRAF) and one in S6 for adverse prognostic factors (K74), so O3 and O10 are covered on the main path.
Report: name the first wrong model to fix from the trap that was fell_open or fell_recovered soonest, and differentiate objective text by what the walk showed.
unscored_notes: Not gated. No typing, no run-time model, and no broken edge found in the walked branches (the misconceived sim reached END with no dead end). Facts are not judged (CLAUDE.md). Claim IDs were checked only for presence in module.json; the claim-bank file was not read because the module embeds its claim texts.
